installers.heading: SKIA Forge PC app installers
installers.macIntelAria: Download SKIA Forge for macOS Intel
installers.macArmAria: Download SKIA Forge for Apple Silicon
installers.noneVerified: No installer is listed. This release has no published SHA-512 for these platforms.
installers.verifyStep1: Download the installer for your platform from the cards below. A platform is shown only when its SHA-512 is published.
installers.verifyStep2: Copy the SHA-512 shown on that card. It is the base64 digest from the release manifest.
installers.verifyStep3: Compute the SHA-512 of the file you downloaded and compare it to the value on the card. On Windows PowerShell: [Convert]::ToBase64String([System.Security.Cryptography.SHA512]::Create().ComputeHash([System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes("installer"))). On macOS or Linux: openssl dgst -sha512 -binary installer | openssl base64 -A
installers.verifyStep4: If the values do not match, do not install the file. Report it through Contact & Support.
